version: 0.15.0

### Added

- Add the `ginkoDocs: { brick }` option (with `docsCollection({ brick })`), so a site can name its docs brick otherwise than `docs`, for example `wissen`. ([#92](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/92))

### Fixed

- Fix pages moving while images load: the card image (`::card{image}`) now gets the image's width and height (`imageWidth`, `imageHeight`), and so does the enlarged image of a figure. ([#92](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/92))
- Fix links to a draft or unpublished entry: the page now shows the link text without a link, instead of an address such as `$docs.kosten` that opens a 404. ([#92](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/92))
